column1: STATS 2035 - STATISTICS FOR BUS & SOC SCI

column1: STATS 2503B - ADV MATH FOR STAT APPLICATION
column2: Course Description: Modeling deterministic systems with differential equations: first and second order ODEs, systems of linear differential equations. Laplace transforms and moment generating functions. Modeling stochastic systems with Markov chains: discrete and continuous time chains, Chapman-Kolmogorov equations, ergodic theorems.
